description: Taipei Meowcast 2026 calendar: 24 solar terms, Taiwan public holidays and major Chinese/Western festivals. If multiple observances share a date, the primary event drives artwork and additional observances are stored in also.

2026-01-01.caption_en: A fresh year begins — may your days be bright, gentle, and full of little adventures.
2026-01-01.caption_zh: 新的一年開始了，願日子明亮溫柔，也有好多值得期待的小冒險。

2026-01-05.caption_en: Minor Cold is here. Keep warm and save a sunny spot for yourself.
2026-01-05.caption_zh: 小寒到了，記得穿暖一點，也替自己留一個曬得到陽光的位置。

2026-01-20.caption_en: Major Cold marks the deepest chill of the season. Warm paws, warm drinks, warm heart.
2026-01-20.caption_zh: 大寒是一年最冷的時節之一。暖暖手腳、喝杯熱飲，也把心照顧暖一點。

2026-02-04.caption_en: Spring begins quietly today — a tiny green promise is already on its way.
2026-02-04.caption_zh: 立春了。春天總是安安靜靜地來，一點點綠意正在路上。

2026-02-14.caption_en: Love can be grand or tiny — a warm drink, a kind word, a seat saved beside you.
2026-02-14.caption_zh: 愛不一定轟轟烈烈，也可以是一杯熱飲、一句溫柔，或替你留好的位置。

2026-02-16.caption_en: Tonight is for coming home, sharing a table, and keeping the people we love close.
2026-02-16.caption_zh: 除夕夜，回家吃頓飯，把珍惜的人好好放在身邊。

2026-02-17.caption_en: Happy Lunar New Year! May your year be cozy, lucky, and full of happy paws.
2026-02-17.caption_zh: 新年快樂！願新的一年平安順心，好運和幸福都像貓腳印一樣一路跟著你。

2026-02-18.caption_en: Rain Water arrives — the air softens, the earth wakes, and spring starts to feel real.
2026-02-18.caption_zh: 雨水到了，空氣漸漸柔軟，大地甦醒，春天開始有了真正的模樣。

2026-02-28.caption_en: A quiet day to remember history, cherish peace, and hold space for reflection.
2026-02-28.caption_zh: 記得歷史，也珍惜和平。今天留一點安靜的時間給記憶與思考。

2026-03-03.caption_en: Lanterns glow, tangyuan are sweet, and the first full moon of the lunar year lights the night.
2026-03-03.caption_zh: 元宵燈亮、湯圓甜甜，農曆新年的第一輪圓月也照亮了夜晚。

2026-03-05.caption_en: Spring thunder wakes the sleeping world. Time to stretch, blink, and begin again.
2026-03-05.caption_zh: 驚蟄春雷喚醒沉睡的大地。伸個懶腰，新的季節真的醒來了。

2026-03-08.caption_en: Here’s to every woman growing, choosing, resting, creating, and living life in her own way.
2026-03-08.caption_zh: 祝福每一位女性，都能依自己的步調成長、選擇、休息、創造與生活。

2026-03-14.caption_en: A little sweetness returned is still sweetness. Save some tenderness for yourself, too.
2026-03-14.caption_zh: 收到溫柔，也別忘了把一點甜留給自己。

2026-03-20.caption_en: Day and night share the sky equally today. Spring has found its balance.
2026-03-20.caption_zh: 春分，晝夜幾乎等長。春天在今天找到剛剛好的平衡。

2026-04-01.caption_en: Today’s forecast: a 100% chance of tiny mischief. Believe the cat at your own risk.
2026-04-01.caption_zh: 今日預報：小惡作劇機率 100%。至於貓說的話，要不要相信就看你囉。

2026-04-04.caption_en: May every child have time to play, room to wonder, and grown-ups who listen.
2026-04-04.caption_zh: 願每個孩子都有玩耍的時間、好奇的空間，也有願意好好聽他說話的大人。

2026-04-05.caption_en: Qingming brings clear light and remembrance — a gentle day to think of those we miss.
2026-04-05.caption_zh: 清明天光澄澈，也是思念的日子。把想念輕輕放在心裡。

2026-04-20.caption_en: Grain Rain is here. Spring rain nourishes the earth before summer begins.
2026-04-20.caption_zh: 穀雨到了。春天最後的雨水滋養大地，也悄悄替夏天鋪路。

2026-04-22.caption_en: One little planet, one shared home. Be gentle with it today and every day.
2026-04-22.caption_zh: 只有一個地球，也是我們共同的家。今天和每一天，都對它溫柔一點。

2026-05-01.caption_en: For everyone whose work keeps life moving: may today include a well-earned pause.
2026-05-01.caption_zh: 謝謝每一份讓生活繼續運轉的勞動。今天也記得替辛苦的自己留一點休息。

2026-05-05.caption_en: Summer begins. Longer light, warmer air, and a new season at the window.
2026-05-05.caption_zh: 立夏，夏天登場。白晝變長、空氣變暖，窗邊也換上新的季節。

2026-05-10.caption_en: For every kind of mothering love: thank you for the countless small things that make a home feel safe.
2026-05-10.caption_zh: 謝謝每一種母愛，以及那些數不清、讓家變得安心的小事。

2026-05-21.caption_en: Grain Buds reminds us: not everything has to be completely full to be enough.
2026-05-21.caption_zh: 小滿，是將滿未滿。原來不必事事圓滿，剛剛好也可以很好。

2026-06-05.caption_en: A season for planting and growing. Some good things begin with patient, ordinary work.
2026-06-05.caption_zh: 芒種，是播種也是生長的時節。有些美好的事，就是從耐心又平凡的努力開始。

2026-06-19.caption_en: Dragon boats race and zongzi are ready — summer traditions are officially here.
2026-06-19.caption_zh: 龍舟出發、粽子上桌，熟悉的夏日節氣又回來了。

2026-06-21.caption_en: The longest daylight of the year is here. Let a little extra sunshine into your day.
2026-06-21.caption_zh: 夏至，一年白晝最長的時候。今天就多收下一點陽光吧。

2026-07-07.caption_en: Minor Heat arrives. Summer is getting serious — shade and cool drinks are good friends.
2026-07-07.caption_zh: 小暑到了，夏天開始認真熱起來。陰影、涼風和冰飲都是好朋友。

2026-07-23.caption_en: Major Heat is here. Move slowly, stay hydrated, and let the afternoon take its time.
2026-07-23.caption_zh: 大暑來了。慢一點、多喝水，最熱的午後不用急著趕路。

2026-08-07.caption_en: Autumn begins on the calendar, even if Taipei still feels like summer.
2026-08-07.caption_zh: 立秋了。雖然台北可能還很有夏天的樣子，秋天已經先在日曆上報到。

2026-08-08.caption_en: For the dads who show love in big ways and quiet ways — happy Father’s Day.
2026-08-08.caption_zh: 祝福那些用各種方式守護家人的爸爸們，父親節快樂。

2026-08-19.caption_en: Under the summer night sky, Qixi is a lovely excuse to tell someone: I’m glad you’re here.
2026-08-19.caption_zh: 七夕的夏夜，剛好適合告訴重要的人：很高興有你在。

2026-08-23.caption_en: End of Heat means summer is beginning to loosen its grip. Cooler days are slowly on their way.
2026-08-23.caption_zh: 處暑，暑氣開始慢慢退場。再等等，舒服一點的日子正在靠近。

2026-08-27.caption_en: A traditional day of remembrance and respect. Keep tonight calm, warm, and gentle.
2026-08-27.caption_zh: 中元節，是慎終追遠與表達敬意的傳統日子。今晚安安靜靜、平平安安就很好。

2026-09-07.caption_en: White Dew arrives. Mornings soften, nights cool down, and autumn becomes easier to notice.
2026-09-07.caption_zh: 白露到了。清晨更柔、夜晚漸涼，秋天開始變得看得見也感受得到。

2026-09-23.note_en: Day and night in balance. A gentler season begins.
2026-09-23.caption_en: Day and night in balance. A gentler season begins.
2026-09-23.caption_zh: 秋分，晝夜平分。天氣也開始走向更溫柔的季節。

2026-09-25.caption_en: One bright moon, many different windows. May everyone you miss feel a little closer tonight.
2026-09-25.caption_zh: 同一輪月亮，照著不同的窗。願今晚想念的人，都感覺離彼此近一點。

2026-09-28.name_zh: 教師節／孔子誕辰紀念日
2026-09-28.caption_en: For every teacher who opened a door, sparked a question, or believed a little longer — thank you.
2026-09-28.caption_zh: 謝謝每一位曾為孩子打開一扇門、點亮一個問題，或多相信他一下的老師。

2026-10-08.caption_en: Cold Dew arrives. Autumn mornings are cooler now — perfect weather for a slower walk.
2026-10-08.caption_zh: 寒露到了，秋晨更涼了。很適合放慢腳步，好好走一段路。

2026-10-10.caption_en: A festive October day in Taiwan — Taipei is dressed for the occasion.
2026-10-10.caption_zh: 十月的節慶日，台北也換上了應景的城市風景。

2026-10-18.caption_en: Double Ninth is a day to care for elders, climb high, and appreciate the long road behind us.
2026-10-18.caption_zh: 重陽節，關心長輩、登高望遠，也珍惜一路走來累積的歲月。

2026-10-23.caption_en: Frost’s Descent closes out autumn. The air grows crisp and winter waits nearby.
2026-10-23.caption_zh: 霜降，是秋天最後一個節氣。空氣漸涼，冬天已經在不遠處等著了。

2026-10-25.name_zh: 臺灣光復暨金門古寧頭大捷紀念日
2026-10-25.caption_en: A commemorative day in Taiwan’s calendar — a moment to remember history and its many layers.
2026-10-25.caption_zh: 今天是臺灣的紀念日之一，留一點時間回望歷史，也理解其中不同的記憶與層次。

2026-10-31.caption_en: Tiny costumes, glowing pumpkins, and just enough mischief — happy Halloween!
2026-10-31.caption_zh: 小小變裝、亮亮南瓜，再加一點剛剛好的搗蛋。萬聖節快樂！

2026-11-07.caption_en: Winter begins. Time for warmer meals, softer blankets, and earlier sunsets.
2026-11-07.caption_zh: 立冬了。熱一點的飯、軟一點的被子，還有一天比一天早的夕陽。

2026-11-22.caption_en: Minor Snow arrives on the calendar. Taipei may not see snow, but winter is settling in.
2026-11-22.caption_zh: 小雪到了。台北也許不下雪，但冬天的氣息已經慢慢住下來了。

2026-11-26.caption_en: A good day to notice what quietly makes life better — and say thank you.
2026-11-26.caption_zh: 今天很適合看看那些默默讓生活變好的事，然後好好說一聲謝謝。

2026-12-07.caption_en: Major Snow marks deeper winter. Even without snow in Taipei, the season asks us to slow down.
2026-12-07.caption_zh: 大雪，冬意更深。即使台北沒有雪，這個季節也提醒我們把步調放慢一點。

2026-12-22.caption_en: The longest night turns toward the light. Have something warm, share a tangyuan, and stay cozy.
2026-12-22.caption_zh: 冬至，最長的夜晚也開始轉向光。吃點熱的、來顆湯圓，暖暖過一天。

2026-12-24.caption_en: Christmas lights are glowing. May your evening be peaceful, cozy, and full of little joys.
2026-12-24.caption_zh: 聖誕燈亮起來了。願今晚平安、溫暖，也裝滿小小的快樂。

2026-12-25.caption_en: Merry Christmas from Taipei Cat! May your day be warm, bright, and wonderfully cozy.
2026-12-25.caption_zh: 台北貓祝你聖誕快樂！願今天溫暖、明亮，還有滿滿舒服的幸福感。

2026-12-31.caption_en: One last Taipei night before a brand-new year. Keep the good, release the rest, and look forward.
2026-12-31.caption_zh: 今年最後一個台北夜晚。把好的留下，其餘輕輕放下，一起期待新的一年。
